Name: UFC Tracker

Actions.Name: Next Event
Actions.Tooltip: The next card, its main event, and a countdown once it is close. Press to refresh.

Description: Fight night on your deck. The next card, who is fighting, and how the night is going, updating on its own while you play or stream. No alt-tabbing to check the card. Not affiliated with or endorsed by UFC or any promotion or fighter.
